notes: Vertex AI embedContent (aiplatform v1beta1 discovery, revision 20261012: projects.locations.publishers.models.embedContent -> EmbedContentResponse {embedding {values}, usageMetadata, truncated}); googleapis/go-genai models.go embedContentResponseFromVertex reads the same fields and, through tIsVertexEmbedContentModel, sends Gemini embedding models other than gemini-embedding-001 to embedContent one content at a time. Vertex AI publisher models have no batchEmbedContents method (the discovery document lists embedContent, predict, countTokens, computeTokens, generateContent, streamGenerateContent and the raw predicts), so the adapter's multi-input path is answered not found. The body is the google.rpc.Status a Google API answers for an unknown method; its exact text is unverified. Recordable through cmd/contract-recorder's Vertex AI upstream (VERTEX_PROJECT and VERTEX_ACCESS_TOKEN, optional VERTEX_LOCATION); the scheduled jobs skip vertex@ models, because the access token lasts an hour, so record it locally.
